title: Study of supported heteropolyacid catalysts for one-step DME synthesis from CO2 and H2
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38-47
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07964G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Anne Wesner, Nick Herrmann, Lasse Prawitt, Angela Ortmann, Jakob Albert, Maximilian J. Poller
In this study, various heteropolyacid (HPA) catalysts on different support materials were synthesized and tested in combination with a Cu-based methanol synthesis catalyst for the single-step synthesis of dimethyl ether (DME) from CO2 and H2.
